research_role.cycle24: Development domain. Future train/validation/independent-holdout splits must respect ENTITY_GROUP_ID.
research_role.cycle25: Frozen temporal transfer/test domain. Must not be used for model fitting, preprocessing fitting, feature selection, hyperparameter tuning, or threshold tuning.

sampling_contract.sampling_method: Fixed absolute 2-hour TAI timestamp grid; never every-Nth-available-row sampling.

label_contract.target: At least one GOES M1.0+ flare associated with the SHARP row NOAA metadata within the next 24 hours.
label_contract.positive: At least one matching region-assigned M1.0+ event in the forecast window.
label_contract.negative: No matching assigned M1.0+ event and no region-unassigned M1.0+ event in the forecast window.
label_contract.boundary_policy: Require complete 24-hour outcome horizon inside the frozen cycle domain.
label_contract.goes_region_normalization: For audited GOES catalogs: active_region < 10000 -> +10000; already-full NOAA values retained. No generic modulo normalization.

qc_contract.QC1: Valid HARPNUM and T_REC; unique key.
qc_contract.QC2: Exact one-to-one SHARP/Lorentz merge on HARPNUM + T_REC.
qc_contract.QC6: All 25 model features finite; no blind imputation.

leakage_contract.quarantine_rule: Any ENTITY_GROUP_ID occurring in both Cycle24 and Cycle25 primary datasets is removed from both domains. Rule is label-blind.

immutability_rule: Dataset v1 files must not be modified in place. Any methodological or data change requires a new dataset version.
